name: IchiPitchy
summary: Browser vocal studio with free, unmetered auto-tune, note-by-note pitch editing, harmony and multitrack mixing; Pro unlocks exports, AI isolation and AI tracks.
description: Browser vocal studio with free, unmetered auto-tune, note-by-note pitch editing, harmony and multitrack mixing; Pro unlocks exports, AI isolation and AI tracks.

pricing.details: Vocal tuning, auto-tune, note-by-note editing, harmony, recording, backing-band generator, multitrack mixing, key/BPM detection and MIDI export are free and unmetered. A free monthly allowance covers audio exports, AI isolation and the AI assistant. IchiPitchy Pro 6 €/month or 53 €/year removes those limits and adds AI track generation.
pricing.label: Freemium
